items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: He said, well, Admiral Nimitz, whatever that's what he's saying. Nimitz.

ctx.x: . What kind of pattern is it? That's a pan of metal. Oh, pan of metal. I got a wood on it. Oh, you've got the adjustable barrel on it. Yeah. You can make it longer. Yeah. Is that the kind that Louis Cotterl had?

It's going again now. Well anyhow, she called me out the swimming pool so I went. I was in good shape then. Hadn't been sick in my life, see. I asked him what do you want? He said, well, Admiral Nimitz, whatever that's what he's saying. Nimitz.
